description: `setDepletionDuration(_duration)` is `onlyOwner` and only requires `_duration > 0`. After accruing under the OLD rate, it recomputes `rewardPerSecond = rewardBalance * PRECISION / depletionDuration`. Setting `_duration = 1` makes `rewardPerSecond = rewardBalance * 1e18`, so the very next `_updatePool` (triggered by any user interaction, including the owner's own follow-up call) distributes the entire `rewardBalance` to whichever stakers are present at that instant — a single-tx "pull the rug forward" lever. Owner can use this to favor a chosen address (own pre-positioned stake) by sandwiching. Matches CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN. There is no on-chain delay on this setter, unlike setDesiredAPY.
vulnerableConditionsMet: No upper or lower bound beyond `> 0`
Combined with absence of nonReentrant on stake/withdraw/claim, owner can position+drain in same block
